key_idea: Only 300 distinct sizes: for one size take the most valuable items first, so the gain is a concave prefix-sum function, and the transition within each residue class mod s has monotone optimal split points (divide and conquer optimisation).
sketch: Group jewels by size and sort each group descending with prefix sums pre (keep only k/s items). For size s and residue r, new[r+j*s] = max_i old[r+i*s] + pre[j-i]; since pre is concave the argmax is monotone in j, so solve each residue chain with divide-and-conquer DP. Total O(300 * k log k) plus sorting, about 0.5s on max input. Pitfalls: limit j-i to the number of items of that size, values up to 1e9*1e5 need int64, and print 0 for capacities nothing fits. Stress-tested against plain 0/1 knapsack.
